baseline_failure_pairs.reason: Generated three screens and invented product assumptions before an approved brief.
Committed a navigation direction before binding From-scratch inputs were approved.
Generated information-architecture hypotheses before the content/state baseline and rubric were ready.
Allowed sibling exposure, shared-skeleton anchoring, and score averaging before independent freeze.

candidate_miss_patterns: Did not consistently distinguish Blocking Unknowns from Working Assumptions in the user-facing response.
Did not consistently require Product Owner reapproval after material constraint changes.
Did not consistently enumerate the complete binding From-scratch set or the full precedent context/rights/transformation/limitations record.
Did not consistently identify all data gaps or contradictory evidence when compressing a response.
Used Not yet evidenced rather than Fail for one observed ethics/privacy/welfare violation.
Did not consistently require semantic structure and complete content/data-rule checks during G5 implementation assurance.
limitations: All graders were model graders providing structural assistance, not qualified multidisciplinary humans.
The exact service-side model identifier was not exposed; every sample inherited the same Codex parent configuration without overrides.
Conservative expectation credit required both graders to agree, so five candidate and four baseline expectation disagreements counted as failures.
No representative-user or production evidence was collected; the fixtures tested product-neutral advice and governance behavior only.
The frozen candidate must change and the full matched benchmark must be rerun before qualified human review or a product pilot.
